messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for SOC 2 fieldwork we need a snapshot proving the recent RBAC change (PR #6789) didn’t expand privileges and that the KMS rotation didn’t leave decryptable artifacts. Request: 1) role-change diff, 2) auth logs for change window, 3) KMS rotation manifest & proof, 4) vuln triage link + postmortem.

maria: Hey — Maria from Security. I can assemble. Quick Q: do you want a full 90-day trail or narrow window? We’ll provide a signed manifest and checksums.

auditor_jane: 90-day is ideal for SOC2, but we can accept 7 days if you include change window ±24h and chain-of-custody details. Need checksums for each artifact.

jonas: Ops here — we’ll export CloudTrail + auth events from Splunk. I’ll drop an export to the evidence bucket. Path: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1704204040/rbac-delta.jsonl.gz (presigned link will be provided, expires in 7d).

jonas: Command we used to pull the file: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/1704204040/rbac-delta.jsonl.gz .`

jonas: sample log line for the rolebinding update:
`{"time":"2026-03-16T14:02:11Z","actor":"deploy-bot","action":"rolebinding.update","target":"team-data-read","request_id":"req-9a8b"}`

maria: KMS rotation details: rotation executed 2026-03-15T01:00:00Z. Key versions are in KMS metadata and we exported the rotation manifest at `/evidence/keys/rotation-manifest-2026-03-15.json` (sha256: abc123def456...). We’ll include DescribeKey/GetPublicKey outputs and the KMS audit bundle.

lee: oncall — confirmed no unexpected iam:PassRole or iam:AttachRolePolicy calls during the rollout. Added a timeline to the incident page: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-2026-42 (internal).

auditor_jane: Need proof there were no plaintext copies created during rotation. Please include object list + ETag + encryption context for any re-encrypted objects and a test showing old key cannot decrypt new ciphertexts.

maria: We’ll include a sampling manifest (10 sample objects), ETags, encryption context, and a decrypt-failure test. Example command we’ll show in artifacts:

```
# attempt decrypt with old key (expected to fail)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/old-key-arn || echo "decrypt failed as expected"
```

jonas: vuln triage note: CVE-2026-0423 impacted one dependency in the inference runtime. Patched image rolled 2026-03-14. PR #6789 removed a clusterrole that was unnecessary. Triage and timeline: https://go.redwood/triage/CVE-2026-0423

auditor_jane: Okay — send artifacts to auditor.soc2@redwood.com and include MD5/sha256 for each file plus GPG signature if possible. Also confirm who approved the RBAC PR and whether any emergency workaround or hotpatch was pushed during rotation.

maria: Will bundle and sign with our GPG key. ETA 2 business days for full package; I’ll PM presigned links when uploaded.

ops_bot: presigned URLs created: https://s3-presigned.example/xyz (valid 7d)

auditor_jane: Also need approver identities and approval timestamps in the manifest; and a clear statement that no emergency workarounds were used.

lee: PR approved by @alex and @maria. No emergency hotfixes were created — rollout used standard canary process. I’ll add that statement to the manifest.

maria: Added approvers list & timestamps to the manifest. Final deliverables we’ll upload: role-diff, auth-logs (jsonl), kms-rotation-manifest, sample object list + encryption-context, signed manifest, checksum list, and triage/postmortem link. I’ll include a short README with commands used to generate each artifact.

auditor_jane: Great — thanks. :thumbsup: 

maria: uploading now, will DM links once complete.
